dua.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
dua.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati l-ʾislāmi, wa ʿalā ka-limati l-ʾikhlāṣi, wa ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā muḥammadin ṣallā llāh ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa ʿalā millati abīnā ibrāhīma, ḥanīfan musliman wamā kāna mina l-mushrikīn
dua.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, the declaration of sincere faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him), and the faith of our forefather Ibraheem, who was upright, a Muslim, and not among those who associate partners with Allah.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (17 of 24)

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdih
dua.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (18 of 24)

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (19 of 24)

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (20 of 24)

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna llāhi wa bi-ḥamdihi: ʿadada khalqihi, wa riḍā nafsihi, wa zinata ʿarshihi, wa midāda ka-li-mātih
dua.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (21 of 24)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalā
dua.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.

steps.arabic: إذا أصبحَ
steps.text: Say this in the morning.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (22 of 24)

dua.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
dua.transliteration: Astaghfiru llāha wa atūbu ilayh
dua.translation: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (23 of 24)

dua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
dua.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
dua.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.

entries.title: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (24 of 24)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyinā muḥammad
dua.translation: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (1 of 13)

steps.arabic: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا: … ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ)
steps.text: When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet would hold his palms together, spit A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle in them, recite the last three chapters Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.

dua.arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul huwa llāhu aḥadun allāhu aṣ-ṣamadu lam yalid walam yūlad walam yakun llahu kufūan aḥadun bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi l-falaqi min sharri mā khalaqa wamin sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqaba wamin sharri an-naffāthāti fī l-ʿuqadi wamin sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasada bismi llāh ar-raḥmān ar-raḥīm qul aʿūdhu birabbi an-nāsi maliki an-nāsi ilāhi an-nāsi min sharri l-waswāsi l-khannāsi alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri an-nāsi mina l-jinnati wa an-nās
dua.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 112:1 Say: He is Allah, the One. 112:2 Allah, the One on whom all depend. 112:3 He neither begets nor was born. 112:4 Nothing is comparable to Him. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 113:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, 113:2 from the evil of what He created, 113:3 from the evil of darkness when it settles, 113:4 from the evil of those who blow upon knots, 113:5 and from the evil of an envier when he envies. In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. 114:1 Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind, 114:2 the King of humankind, 114:3 the God of humankind, 114:4 from the evil of the retreating whisperer, 114:5 who whispers into people’s hearts, 114:6 whether from the jinn or humankind.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (2 of 13)

dua.arabic: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
dua.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa l-ḥayyu l-qayyūmu lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun walā nawmun llahu mā fī as-samawāti wamā fī l-ʾarḍi man dhā alladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnihi yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin mmin ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ wasiʿa kursiyyuhu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍa walā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā wahuwa l-ʿaliyyu l-ʿaẓīm
dua.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. Everything in the heavens and on the earth belongs to Him. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before people and what lies beyond them, while they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (3 of 13)

dua.arabic: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾
dua.transliteration: Āmana ar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rrabbihi wa-l-muʾminūna kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa malʾāʾikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin mmin rrusulihi wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilayka l-maṣīru lā yukallifu llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā lahā mā ka-sabat wa ʿalayhā mā iktasabat rabbanā lā tuʾākhidhnā in nnasīnā aw akhṭaʾnā rabbanā walā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿalā alladhīna min qablinā rabbanā walā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa iʿfu ʿannā wa ighfir lanā wa irḥamnā anta mawlānā fānṣurnā ʿalā l-qawmi l-kāfirīn
dua.translation: 285 The Messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord, as do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His scriptures, and His messengers. “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” They say, “We hear and obey. Our Lord, we seek Your forgiveness, and to You is the final return.” 286 Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It receives the good it earns and bears the evil it commits. “Our Lord, do not hold us to account if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place upon us a burden like the one You placed upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (4 of 13)

dua.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
dua.transliteration: Bi-ismika rabbī wa ḍaʿtu janbī, wabika arfaʿuhu, faʾin amsakta nafsī frḥamhā, waʾin arsaltahā fa iḥfaẓhā, bimā taḥfaẓu bihi ʿibādaka aṣ-ṣāliḥīn
dua.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (5 of 13)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka khalaqta nafsī wa anta tawaffāhā, laka mamātuhā wa maḥyhā, in aḥyaytahā fa iḥfaẓhā, waʾin amattahā fa ighfir lahā. allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyah
dua.translation: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (6 of 13)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma qinī ʿadhābaka yawma tabʿathu ʿibādak
dua.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (7 of 13)

dua.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
dua.transliteration: Bi-ismika llāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā
dua.translation: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (8 of 13)

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna llāh
dua.translation: Glory be to Allah.

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah.

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhu akbar
dua.translation: Allah is the Greatest.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (9 of 13)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi warabba l-ʾarḍi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, rabbanā warabba kulli shayʾin, fa-l-qa l-ḥabbi wa an-nawā, wa munzila at-tawrāti wa-l-ʾinjīli, wa-l-furqāni, aʿūdhu bika min sharri kulli shayʾin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatih. allāhumma anta l-ʾawwalu fa laysa qablaka shayʾun, wa anta l-ʾākhiru fa laysa baʿdaka shayʾun, wa anta aẓ-ẓāhiru fa laysa fawqaka shayʾun, wa anta l-bāṭinu fa laysa dūnaka shayʾun, iqḍi ʿannā ad-dayna wa aghninā mina l-faqr
dua.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock i.e. You have total mastery over. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (10 of 13)

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā, wa ka-fānā, wa āwānā, fakam mimman lā kāfiya lahu walā muʾwiy
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (11 of 13)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿālima l-ghaybi wa ash-shahādati fāṭira as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkahu, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wamin sharri ash-shayṭni wa shirkihi, waʾan aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sūʾan, aw ajurrahu ilā muslim
dua.translation: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (12 of 13)

steps.arabic: يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَةِ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ
steps.text: He recites Alif Lām Mīm Tanzīl (Surat as-Sajdah, 32) and Tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mulk (Surat al-Mulk, 67).

entries.title: What to say before sleeping (13 of 13)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma aslamtu nafsī ilayka, wa fawwaḍtu amrī ilayka, wa wajjahtu wajhī ilayka, wa aljaʾtu ẓahrī ilayka, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka, lā maljaʾa walā manjā minka illā ilayka, āmantu bi-kitābika alladhī anzalta, wa bi-nabiyyika alladhī arsalt
dua.translation: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

entries.title: Invocation to say if you stir in the night

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-wāḥidu l-qahhru, rabbu as-samawāti wa-l-ʾarḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazyzu l-ghaffār
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.

entries.title: What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed

dua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
dua.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābihi, washarri ʿibādihi, wamin hamazāti ash-shayṭīni waʾan yaḥḍurūn
dua.translation: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.

entries.title: What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare (1 of 2)

steps.arabic: [ (يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ (ثلاثاً)) - (يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ)) - ((لاَ يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَداً)) - ((يَتَحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ)) ]
steps.text: [ Spit on your left three times Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle - Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw Three Times - Do not relate it to anyone - Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously. - Get up and pray if you so desire. ]

entries.title: What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare (2 of 2)

steps.arabic: ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ
steps.text: Get up and pray if you so desire.

entries.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (1 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ihdinī fīman hadayta, wa ʿāfinī fīman ʿāfayta, wa tawallanī fīman tawallayta, wa bārik lī fīmā aʿṭayta, wa qinī sharra mā qaḍayta; fa innaka taqḍī walā yuqḍā ʿalayka, innahu lā yadhillu man wa-l-yta, walā yaʿizzu man ʿādayta tabrakta rabban wa taʿālayt
dua.translation: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.

entries.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (2 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bi-riḍāka min sakhaṭika, wa bi-muʿāfātika min ʿuqūbatika, wa aʿūdhu bika minka, lā uḥṣī thanāʾan ʿalayka, anta kamā athnayta ʿalā nafsik
dua.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.

entries.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer (3 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma iyyāka nʿbudu, walaka nuṣallī wa nasjudu, wa ilayka nasʿā wa naḥfidu, narjū raḥmataka, wa nakhshā ʿadhābaka, inna ʿadhābaka bi-l-kāfirīna mulḥaq. allāhumma innā nastaʿynuka, wa nastaghfiruka, wa nuthnī ʿalayka l-khayra, walā nakfuruka, wa nuʾminu bika, wa nakhḍaʿu laka, wa nakhlaʿu man yakfruk
dua.translation: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.

entries.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

steps.arabic: والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ:
steps.text: On the third repetition, raise and prolong your voice, then add:

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna l-maliki l-quddūs
dua.translation: Glory be to the King, the Most Holy.

dua.arabic: رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
dua.transliteration: Rabbi l-malāʾikati wa ar-rūḥ
dua.translation: Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

entries.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ʿabduka, ibnu ʿabdika, ibnu amatika, nāṣiyatī bi-yadika, māḍin fīa ḥukmuka, ʿadlun fīa qaḍāʾuka, asʾaluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fī kitābika, aw ʿallamtahu aḥadan min khalqika, awi istaʾtharta bihi fī ʿilmi l-ghaybi ʿindaka, an tajʿala l-qurʾāna rabīʿa qalbī, wa nūra ṣadrī, wa jalāʾa ḥuznī, wa dhahāba hammī
dua.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand i.e. You have total mastery over, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

entries.title: Invocations in times of worry and grief (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
dua.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

entries.title: Invocations for anguish (1 of 4)

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿaẓīmu l-ḥalīmu, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, lā ilāha illā llāhu rabbu as-samawāti warabbu l-ʾarḍi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.

entries.title: Invocations for anguish (2 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū, falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿaynin, wa aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullahu, lā ilāha illā ant
dua.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

entries.title: Invocations for anguish (3 of 4)

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina aẓ-ẓlimīn
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.

entries.title: Invocations for anguish (4 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
dua.transliteration: Allāhu llāhu rabbī lā ushriku bihi shayʾā
dua.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

entries.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (1 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim
dua.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.

entries.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (2 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī, wa anta naṣīrī, bika aḥūlu wabika aṣūlu, wabika uqtil
dua.translation: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.

entries.title: Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (3 of 3)

dua.arabic: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
dua.transliteration: Ḥasbun allāhu wa niʿma l-wakīl
dua.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee He is.

entries.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma rbba as-samawāti as-sabʿi, warabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi, kun lī jāran min fulāni bni fulānin, wa aḥzābihi min khalāʾiqika, an yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, ʿazza jāruka, wajalla thanāʾuka, walā ilāha illā ant
dua.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

entries.title: Invocations against the oppression of rulers (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu aʿazzu min khalqihi jamīʿan, allāhu aʿazzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdharu, aʿūdhu bi-llāhi alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, al-mumsiki as-samawāti as-sabʿi an yaqaʿna ʿalā l-ʾarḍi illā bi-idhnihi, min sharri ʿabdika fulānin, wa junūdihi wa atbāʿihi wa ashyāʿihi, min al-jinni wa-l-ʾinsi, allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanāʾuka waʿazza jāruka, wa tabāraka ismuka, walā ilāha ghayruk
dua.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

entries.title: Invocation against an enemy

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila l-kitābi, sarīʿa l-ḥisābi, ihzimi l-ʾaḥzāba, allāhumma hzimhum wa zalzilhum
dua.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

entries.title: What to say if you fear people may harm you

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinīhim bimā shiʾt
dua.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

entries.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (1 of 3)

steps.arabic: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ و يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ
steps.text: Say: I seek refuge in Allah. Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.

entries.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (2 of 3)

steps.arabic: يَقُولُ:
steps.text: He should say:

dua.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
dua.transliteration: Āmantu bi-llāhi wa rusulih
dua.translation: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.

entries.title: Invocations for if you are stricken by doubt in your faith (3 of 3)

steps.arabic: يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى:
steps.text: He should also recite the following verse:

dua.arabic: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾
dua.transliteration: Huwa l-ʾwwalu wa-l-ʾākhiru wa aẓ-ẓhiru wa-l-bṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
dua.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has full knowledge of everything.

entries.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ikfinī bi-ḥalālika ʿan ḥarāmika, wa aghninī bi-faḍliki ʿamman siwāk
dua.translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.

entries.title: Invocations for the settling of a debt (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazani, wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni, wa ḍalaʿi ad-dayni wa ghalabati ar-rijāl
dua.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.

entries.title: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran

steps.text: othman Ibn Al-ʿAs narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle on your left side

dua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
dua.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
dua.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

steps.arabic: وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ
steps.text: and spit lightly to your left.

entries.title: Invocation for when you find something becoming difficult for you

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā jaʿaltahu sahlan, wa anta tajʿalu l-ḥazna idhā shiʾta sahlā
dua.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

entries.title: What to say and do if you commit a sin

steps.arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
steps.text: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer i.e. two rakʿas and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.

entries.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (1 of 3)

steps.arabic: الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ
steps.text: Seeking refuge from him.

entries.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (2 of 3)

steps.arabic: الْأَذَانُ
steps.text: The Adhaan [call to prayer].

entries.title: Invocations against the Devil and his promptings (3 of 3)

steps.arabic: الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ
steps.text: Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.

entries.title: Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do

dua.arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
dua.transliteration: Qadaru llāhu wamā shāʾa faʿal
dua.translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

entries.title: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

dua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī l-mawhūbi laka, wa shakarta l-wāhiba, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrah
dua.translation: May Allah bless the child granted to you, enable you to thank the Giver, allow the child to reach maturity, and bless you with the child’s dutifulness.

steps.arabic: وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ:
steps.text: The parent replies:

dua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
dua.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jazāka llāhu khayran, wa razaqaka llāhu mithlahu, wa ajzala thawābak
dua.translation: May Allah bless you and shower His blessings upon you, reward you with goodness, grant you a similar blessing, and make your reward abundant.

entries.title: How to seek Allah's protection for children

steps.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما
steps.text: Ibn ʿAbbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:

dua.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
dua.transliteration: Uʿīdhukumā bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin, wamin kulli ʿaynin lāmmah
dua.translation: I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.

entries.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Lā bʾsa ṭahūrun in shāʾa llāh
dua.translation: Never mind, may it the sickness be a purification, if Allah wills.

entries.title: Invocations for visiting the sick (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ
dua.transliteration: Asʾalu llāha l-ʿaẓyma rabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi an yashfyak
dua.translation: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’. 7times he the sick person will be cured.

entries.title: The reward for visiting the sick

steps.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say:

steps.arabic: إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
steps.text: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.

entries.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (1 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lī, wa irḥamnī, wa alḥiqnī bi-ar-rafīqi l-ʾaʿlā
dua.translation: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions

entries.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (2 of 3)

steps.arabic: جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ:
steps.text: 'Aa.ishah radhi-yAllaahu'anhaa related that The Prophet sal-Allaahu'alayhe wa sallam [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu inna lilmawti sakarāt
dua.translation: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’

entries.title: Invocations of the terminally ill (3 of 3)

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu wa-llāhu akbaru, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lā ilāha illā llāhu lahu l-mulku walahu l-ḥamdu, lā ilāha illā llāhu walā ḥawla walā quwwata illā bi-llāh
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.

entries.title: What to encourage the dying person to say

steps.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ
steps.text: He whose last words are:

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāh
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

steps.arabic: دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
steps.text: will enter Paradise.

entries.title: Invocation for when tragedy strikes

dua.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا
dua.transliteration: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūna, allāhumma jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayrā minhā
dua.translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

entries.title: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِـ{{deceasedName}} وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-{{deceasedName}} wa irfaʿ darajatahu fī l-mahdiyyīna, wa ikhlufhu fī ʿaqibihi fī l-ghābirīna, wa ighfir lanā walahu yā rabba l-ʿālamīna, wa ifsaḥ lahu fī qabrihi, wa nawwir lahu fīh
dua.translation: O Allah, forgive {{deceasedName}} and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.

entries.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (1 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu, wa ʿāfihi, wa iʿfu ʿanhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassiʿ mudkhalahu, wa ighsilhu bi-l-māʾi wa ath-thalji wa-l-baradi, wa naqqihi mina l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta ath-thawba l-ʾabyaḍa mina ad-danasi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjā khayran min zawjihi, wa adkhilhu l-jannata, wa aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabri wa ʿadhābi an-nār
dua.translation: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.

entries.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (2 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir li-ḥayyinā wa mayyitinā, wa shāhidinā wa ghāʾibinā, wa ṣaghīrinā wa ka-byrinā, wa dhakarinā wa unthānā. allāhumma man aḥyaytahu minnā fa aḥyihi ʿalā l-ʾislāmi, waman tawaffaytahu minnā fa tawaffahu ʿalā l-ʾīmāni, allāhumma lā taḥrimnā ajrahu, walā tuḍillanā baʿdah
dua.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.

entries.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (3 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma inna fulāna bna fulānin fī dhimmatika, wa ḥabli jiwārika, faqihi min fitnati l-qabri, wa ʿadhābi an-nāri, wa anta ahlu l-wafāʾi wa-l-ḥaqqi, fa ighfir lahu wa irḥamhu innaka anta l-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
dua.translation: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.

entries.title: Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer (4 of 4)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ʿabduka wa ibnu amatika iḥtāja ilā raḥmatika, wa anta ghaniyyun ʿan ʿadhābihi, in kāna muḥsinan fazid fī ḥasanātihi, waʾin kāna musīʾan fa tajāwaz ʿanh
dua.translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.

entries.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma aʿidhhu min ʿadhābi l-qabr
dua.translation: O Allah, protect him from the punishment of the grave.

steps.arabic: وإن قال:
steps.text: Or say:

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu fa raṭan wa dhukhran li-wa ad-dayhi, wa shafīʿan mujāban, allāhumma thaqqil bihi mawāzīnahumā, wa aʿẓim bihi ujwrahumā, wa alḥiqhu bi-ṣāliḥi l-muʾminīna, wa ijʿalhu fī ka-fa-l-ti ibrāhīma, waqihi bi-raḥmatika ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi, wa abdilhu dāran khayran min dārihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, allāhumma ighfir li-aslāfinā, wa afrāṭinā, waman sabaqanā bi-l-ʾīmān
dua.translation: O Allah, make him a forerunner and a treasure for his parents, and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and increase their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous believers, place him in the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of Hell. Grant him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive our predecessors, our children who died before us, and those who preceded us in faith.

steps.arabic: إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ
steps.text: This is also good.

entries.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ijʿalhu lanā fa raṭan, wa salafan, wa ajrā
dua.translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward

entries.title: Invocation for the bereaved

dua.arabic: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
dua.transliteration: Inna li-llāhi mā akhadha, walahu mā aʿṭā, wakullu shayʾin ʿindahu bi-ajalin musammā... faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib
dua.translation: Indeed, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given. Everything with Him has an appointed term. So let her be patient and seek Allah’s reward.

steps.text: The final two Arabic verbs address a woman. Adjust their forms for the person being addressed.

steps.arabic: وَإِنْ قَالَ:
steps.text: Or say:

dua.arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ
dua.transliteration: Aʿẓama llāhu ajraka, wa aḥsana ʿazāʾaka, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
dua.translation: May Allah increase your reward, comfort you in your bereavement, and forgive your deceased.

steps.arabic: فَحَسَنٌ
steps.text: This is also good.

entries.title: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave

dua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāhi wa ʿalā sunnati rasūli llāh
dua.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

entries.title: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ighfir lahu, allāhumma thabbith
dua.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him

entries.title: Invocation for visiting the graves

dua.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
dua.transliteration: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla ad-diyāri, mina l-muʾminīna wa-l-muslimīna, wa innā in shāʾa llāhu bikum lāḥiqūna, wa yarḥamu llāhu l-mustaqdimīna minnā wa-l-mustʾkhirīna asʾalu llāha lanā wa lakumu l-ʿāfiyah
dua.translation: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you. [And may Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who come later.] I ask Allah for well-being for us and you.

entries.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā
dua.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.

entries.title: Invocations for when the wind blows (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa khayra mā ursilat bihi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā fīhā, washarri mā ursilat bih
dua.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.

entries.title: Invocation for when it thunders

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
dua.transliteration: Subḥāna alladhī yusabbiḥu ar-raʿdu bi-ḥamdihi wa-l-malāʾiktu min khīfatih
dua.translation: How perfect He is, The One Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.

entries.title: Some invocations for rain (1 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma isqinā ghaythan mughīthan marīʾan marīʿan, nāfiʿan ghayra ḍārrin, ʿājilan ghayra ājil
dua.translation: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.

entries.title: Some invocations for rain (2 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā, allāhumma aghithnā
dua.translation: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

entries.title: Some invocations for rain (3 of 3)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma isqi ʿibādaka, wa bahāʾimaka, wa inshur raḥmataka, wa aḥyī baladaka l-mayyit
dua.translation: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.

entries.title: Invocation for when it rains

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā
dua.translation: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

entries.title: Supplication after it rains

dua.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
dua.transliteration: Muṭirnā bi-faḍli llāhi wa raḥmatih
dua.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

entries.title: Invocation for the withholding of the rain

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā walā ʿalaynā, allāhumma ʿalā l-ʾākāmi wa aẓ-ẓirābi, wa buṭūni l-ʾawdiyati, wa manābiti ash-shajar
dua.translation: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, let it fall on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.

entries.title: Invocation for sighting the new moon

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhumma ahillahu ʿalaynā bi-l-ʾamni wa-l-ʾīmāni, wa as-salāmati wa-l-ʾislāmi, wa at-tawfīqi limā tuḥibbu rabbanā wa tarḍā, rabbunā wa rabbuka llāh
dua.translation: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

entries.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓamaʾu wa ibtallati l-ʿurūqu, wa thabata l-ʾajru in shāʾa llāh
dua.translation: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

entries.title: Invocations for breaking the fast (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka bi-raḥmatika allatī wa siʿat kulla shayʾin an taghfira lī
dua.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.

entries.title: Invocations before eating (1 of 2)

steps.arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ
steps.text: Before eating, say:

dua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāh
dua.translation: In the name of Allah.

variations.label: If you forgot
variations.condition: If you forgot to mention Allah's name before eating

steps.arabic: فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ
steps.text: If you forgot at the beginning, say:

dua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāhi fī awwalihi wa ākhirih
dua.translation: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.

entries.title: Invocations before eating (2 of 2)

steps.arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ:
steps.text: When Allah provides you with food, say:

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭʿimnā khayran minh
dua.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with food better than it.

steps.arabic: وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ
steps.text: When Allah gives you milk to drink, say:

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
dua.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

entries.title: Invocations after eating (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā, wa razaqanīhi, min ghayri ḥawlin minnī walā quwwah
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.

entries.title: Invocations after eating (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ḥamdan ka-thīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīhi, ghayra makfiyyin walā muwaddaʿin, walā mustaghnayan ʿanhu rabbanā
dua.translation: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.

entries.title: A dinner guest's invocation for his host

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum, wa ighfir lahum wa irḥamhum
dua.translation: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭʿim man aṭʿamanī, wa isqi man saqānī
dua.translation: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

entries.title: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them

dua.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
dua.transliteration: Afṭara ʿindakumu aṣ-ṣāʾimūna, wa akala ṭaʿāmakumu l-ʾabrāru, wa ṣallat ʿalaykumu l-malāʾikah
dua.translation: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who offers you food when you are fasting, which you decline

steps.arabic: ((إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ)) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ
steps.text: If you are invited to a meal, accept the invitation. If you are fasting, supplicate for the host; if you are not fasting, eat.

entries.title: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you

dua.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
dua.transliteration: Innī ṣāʾimun, innī ṣāʾim
dua.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.

entries.title: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā, wa bārik lanā fī ṣāʿinā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā
dua.translation: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saʿ for us and bless our mudd for us.

entries.title: Invocation for sneezing

steps.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ
steps.text: When you sneeze, say:

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah.

steps.arabic: وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ:
steps.text: A companion should reply:

dua.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Yarḥamuka llāh
dua.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.

steps.arabic: فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ:
steps.text: The sneezer should then reply:

dua.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
dua.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
dua.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

entries.title: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah

dua.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
dua.transliteration: Yahdīkumu llāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum
dua.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

entries.title: Invocation for the groom

dua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
dua.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka, wa bāraka ʿalayka, wa jamaʿa baynakumā fī khayr
dua.translation: May Allah bless for you your spouse and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

entries.title: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

steps.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ:
steps.text: when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayrahā, wa khayra mā jabaltahā ʿalayhi, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri mā jabaltahā ʿalayh
dua.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.

steps.arabic: وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
steps.text: and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.

entries.title: Invocation to be recited before intercourse

dua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, allāhumma jannibnā ash-shayṭāna, wa jannibi ash-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā
dua.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

entries.title: Invocation for anger

dua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
dua.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-llāhi mina ash-shayṭāni ar-rajīm
dua.translation: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

entries.title: What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī mimmā ibtalāka bihi, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā ka-thīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.

entries.title: What to say while sitting in an assembly

steps.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ:
steps.text: Ibn ʿUmar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up:

dua.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ
dua.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lī, watub ʿalayya, innaka anta at-tawwābu l-ghafūr
dua.translation: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me to accept my repentance. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.

entries.title: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis

dua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
dua.transliteration: Subḥānaka llāhumma wa bi-ḥamdika, ashhadu an lā ilāha illā anta, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk
dua.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who says: May Allah forgive you

steps.text: ʿAbdullah Ibn Sarjis said: ‘I went to see the Prophet and ate from his food and then said to him: May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah. he replied:

dua.arabic: وَلَكَ
dua.transliteration: Walak
dua.translation: and you.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who does good to you

steps.text: If someone does you a favour and you say:

dua.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً
dua.transliteration: Jazāka llāhu khayrā
dua.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.

steps.text: then you have indeed excelled in praising him.

entries.title: Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah

steps.arabic: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ
steps.text: Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal. One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah

dua.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
dua.transliteration: Aḥabbaka alladhī aḥbabtanī lah
dua.translation: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

dua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
dua.transliteration: Bāraka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik
dua.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

entries.title: Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

dua.arabic: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
dua.transliteration: Braka llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālika, innamā jazāʾu as-salafi l-ḥamdu wa-l-ʾadāʾ
dua.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

entries.title: Invocation for fear of Shirk

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā aʿlamu, wa astaghfiruka limā lā aʿlam
dua.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

entries.title: Invocation for someone who tells you: May Allah bless you

steps.text: Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back from distributing it, ʿAishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: May Allah bless you all. ʿAishah would then say:

dua.arabic: وَفِيكَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ
dua.transliteration: Wa fīka bāraka llāh
dua.translation: and may Allah bless them.

entries.title: Invocation against evil portent

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruka, walā khayra illā khayruka, walā ilāha ghayruk
dua.translation: O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

entries.title: Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

dua.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾، ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ))
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāhi, wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna, wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna l-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, al-ḥamdu li-llāhi, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥānaka llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa ighfir lī; fa innahu lā yaghfiru adh-dhunūba illā ant
dua.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this transport at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.

entries.title: Invocation for traveling

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
dua.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.

dua.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
dua.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, allāhu akbaru, subḥāna alladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna llāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādhā l-birra wa at-taqwā, wamina l-ʿamali mā tarḍā, allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa iṭwi ʿannā buʿdahu, allāhumma anta aṣ-ṣāḥibu fī as-safari, wa-l-khalīfatu fī l-ʾahli, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi as-safari, wa kābati l-manẓari, wa sūʾi l-munqalabi fī l-māli wa-l-ʾahl
dua.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, though we could never have managed it ourselves. Surely, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who watches over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from distressing sights, and from returning to find harm in our wealth or family.

steps.arabic: وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ:
steps.text: When returning, recite the travel supplication again and add:

dua.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
dua.transliteration: Āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbinā ḥāmidūn
dua.translation: We return, repent, worship, and praise our Lord.

entries.title: Invocation for entering a town or city

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
dua.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba as-samawāti as-sabʿi wamā aẓlalna, warabba l-ʾaraḍīna as-sabʿi wamā aqlalna, warabba ash-shayṭīni wamā aḍlalna, warabba ar-riyāḥi wamā dharayna, asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-qaryati, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra mā fīhā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā, washarri ahlihā, washarri mā fīhā
dua.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.

entries.title: Invocation for entering a market

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wahuwa ḥayyun lʾi yamūtu, bi-yadihi l-khayru, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.

entries.title: Invocation for when your vehicle or mount begins to fail

dua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
dua.transliteration: Bismi llāh
dua.translation: In the name of Allah.

entries.title: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

dua.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
dua.transliteration: Astawdiʿukumu llāha alladhī lā taḍīʿu wa dāʾiʿuh
dua.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

entries.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (1 of 2)

dua.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
dua.transliteration: Astawdiʿu llāha dīnaka, wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik
dua.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

entries.title: The resident's invocations for the traveler (2 of 2)

dua.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ
dua.transliteration: Zawwadaka llāhu at-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka l-khayra ḥaythu m kunt
dua.translation: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

entries.title: Glorifying and magnifying Allah on the journey

steps.arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه:
steps.text: Jabir said:

steps.arabic: كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا
steps.text: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu'Akber Allah is the Most Great and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah Glory is to Allah

entries.title: The traveler's invocation at dawn

dua.arabic: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
dua.transliteration: Sammaʿa sāmiʿun bi-ḥamdi llāhi, wa ḥusni balāʾihi ʿalaynā, rabbanā ṣḥibnā, wa afḍil ʿalaynā, ʿāʾidhan bi-llāhi mina an-nār
dua.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.

entries.title: Invocation for a layover (stopping along the way) on the journey

dua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
dua.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-ka-li-māti llāhi at-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
dua.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.

entries.title: What to say upon returning from a Journey

steps.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ:
steps.text: Ibn ʿUmar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. and then he would say:

dua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
dua.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahu l-mulku, walahu l-ḥamdu, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun, āyibūna, tāʾibūna, ʿābidūna, li-rabbin ḥāmidūna, ṣadaqa llāhu waʿdahu, wa naṣara ʿabdahu, wa hazama l-ʾaḥzba waḥdah
dua.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.

entries.title: What to say if something happens to please you or to displease you

steps.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ:
steps.text: When something pleased the Prophet, he would say:

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī bi-niʿmatihi tatimmu aṣ-ṣāliḥāt
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah, by whose grace good things are brought to completion.

steps.arabic: وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ:
steps.text: When something displeased him, he would say:

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
dua.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi ʿalā kulli ḥāl
dua.translation: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.

entries.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (1 of 5)

steps.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Prophet PBUH said:

steps.arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً
steps.text: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.

entries.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (2 of 5)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: He PBUH also said:

steps.arabic: لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ
steps.text: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.

entries.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (3 of 5)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: He PBUH also said:

steps.arabic: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ
steps.text: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.

entries.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (4 of 5)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Prophet [PBUH] said:

steps.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ
steps.text: 'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings or prayers of peace of my'Ummah nation.

entries.title: The excellence of asking for Allah's blessings upon the Prophet PBUH (5 of 5)

steps.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Prophet [PBUH] said:

steps.arabic: مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ
steps.text: 'No one sends greetings or prayers of peace upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings

entries.title: Spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace) (1 of 3)

steps.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
steps.text: The Messenger of Allah said:

steps.arabic: لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ
